summary: Configured traffic mirroring so node3 receives a copy of all traffic node1 exchanges with node2 on their shared L2 segment, while that traffic itself keeps flowing unaffected. Implementation: node1's eth1, node2's ens7, and node3's ens7 form one shared broadcast segment (confirmed empirically - it behaves as a switch, not a hub: unicast node1<->node2 traffic was invisible to node3 before mirroring). Assigned static IPs on the segment (node1 192.168.50.1, node2 192.168.50.2, node3 192.168.50.3), built a GRETAP tunnel from node1 to node3, and installed Linux tc (clsact/flower/mirred) rules on node1's eth1 that mirror (not redirect) packets to/from node2's IP into the tunnel. Node3 decapsulates the tunnel on its local gretap1 interface, where a capture sees the original node1<->node2 packets (still addressed to each other) even though addressed elsewhere. Verified with tcpdump: 10/10 ICMP packets from a 5-ping exchange were mirrored to node3, while the original ping itself showed 0% loss throughout. Made the configuration persistent (systemd oneshot units on node1 and node3, ifupdown drop-in configs for the static IPs on node2/node3) since none of this state survives a reboot by default. Completed the mandatory restart-evidence protocol: captured a healthy baseline (boot IDs + working mirror) on all three nodes, then restarted node1, node2, and node3 one at a time (preserving the segment - no concurrent restarts), confirmed each node's boot ID changed post-restart, and re-verified after each restart that the mirroring service/config auto-recovered and the ping+tcpdump mirror test still passed end-to-end. All three nodes are now healthy with mirroring active and persistent.
actions_performed: Inspected topology: node1 (SONiC/Debian13) eth1, node2/node3 (Ubuntu 16.04) ens7 form one shared L2 segment with no prior L3 addressing
Assigned static IPs 192.168.50.1/2/3 on node1/node2/node3 segment interfaces to enable identification and tunneling
Empirically proved the segment forwards like a switch (node3 did not see node1<->node2 unicast traffic before any mirroring config)
Created a GRETAP tunnel node1<->node3 (gretap1) over the shared segment
Installed tc qdisc clsact + tc flower filters with mirred egress-mirror action on node1's eth1, matching src/dst 192.168.50.2 (node2), sending copies into gretap1
Verified mirroring end-to-end via tcpdump on node3's gretap1 while pinging node1->node2, confirming original traffic had 0% loss

Made the config persistent: systemd oneshot unit node1-mirror.service (recreates IP/gretap/tc rules) on node1; ifupdown drop-in configs for static IPs on node2 and node3; systemd oneshot unit node3-gretap.service on node3 to recreate its gretap1 receiver
Captured healthy baseline (boot IDs, IP/tc/gretap state) on all three nodes

Restarted node1 via native reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot ID, verified all SONiC docker containers came back healthy, and confirmed mirroring config auto-recovered via systemd + full end-to-end ping/tcpdump retest
Restarted node2 via sudo reboot, confirmed new boot ID, confirmed persistent IP recovered, retested mirroring end-to-end
Restarted node3 via sudo reboot, confirmed new boot ID, confirmed persistent IP and node3-gretap.service recovered gretap1, retested mirroring end-to-end (final confirmation)

evidence.requirement: Shared segment topology confirmed (node1 eth1 / node2 ens7 / node3 ens7 on one L2 domain)
evidence.summary: ip -br addr/link and neighbor tables show node1 eth1, node2 ens7, node3 ens7 as the real dataplane NICs on a common unaddressed segment

evidence.requirement: Baseline proof: without mirroring, node3 does not see node1<->node2 unicast traffic (switch behavior, motivates the mirroring solution)
evidence.summary: IPs assigned on segment, then node1 pinged node2 successfully while node3's tcpdump on ens7 captured zero packets, proving traffic was not naturally visible to node3

evidence.requirement: Mirroring implemented and delivers a copy of node1<->node2 traffic to node3
evidence.summary: GRETAP tunnel created node1<->node3; tc clsact/flower/mirred egress-mirror rules installed on node1 eth1 matching node2's IP

evidence.requirement: Original node1<->node2 traffic keeps flowing unaffected while mirrored copy reaches node3
evidence.summary: Ping node1->node2 showed 0% packet loss (5/5) while node3's gretap1 capture simultaneously showed all 10 mirrored ICMP packets

evidence.requirement: Mirroring configuration made persistent across reboot
evidence.summary: Installed ifupdown static-IP configs on node2/node3 and systemd oneshot units (node1-mirror.service, node3-gretap.service) enabled for boot on node1 and node3

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline captured on all 3 nodes before any restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id, uptime, and mirror-relevant interface/tc/gretap state on node1, node2, node3 prior to restarts

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged, boot_id changed from 9094f607... to bd6ba592..., persistent static IP 192.168.50.2 recovered via ifupdown, end-to-end mirror retest passed (10/10 packets, 0% ping loss)
